inputs.text: 3D animated film still, Pixar Disney style. She sits on his lap; he sits on the throne. queen of diamonds with red-orange strawberry-blonde hair wears a diamond tiara and white gown that glimmers under warm cinematic light. king of spades has short silver-grey hair and wears black spade crown atop black-and-silver armor. both wear ornate jewelry: she holds a single diamond necklace; he bears a small spade pendant. baroque gilded throne rises behind them beneath crystal chandeliers and floating rose petals. gold filigree runs along their clothing, lace traces her gown, armor reflects light with subtle shine. big expressive eyes meet: her gaze soft yet intense, his steady and tender. rich textures: velvet fabric, polished metal, flowing hair. shallow depth of field blurs the background into dreamlike haze, intimate connection in quiet romance beneath arches of light and shadow. Her gown shows only diamonds, his armor shows only spades; no letters or text anywhere. He has NO red hair. Glyphs that must appear: spade (♠, black, inverted heart with a short stem) ONLY on him; diamond (♦, red, rotated square) ONLY on her.
